evals.expected_output: Produces a structured project manifest identifying language (Python), build tool (uv/Makefile), test command (make check/pytest), modules (scripts/, agents/, skills/), API surface (MCP tools), security model (none/minimal), test infrastructure (pytest, hypothesis, CI workflows), and spec sources (CLAUDE.md, docs/). Does NOT proceed to Phase 1.
expectations: The manifest identifies Python 3.10+ as the primary language
The manifest identifies uv as the package manager
The manifest identifies make check as the primary test command
The manifest lists modules including scripts/, agents/, skills/
The manifest identifies CI workflows in .github/workflows/
The skill stops after Phase 0 and does not proceed to spec comprehension
The manifest is presented in a structured format (JSON or clear sections)

evals.expected_output: Runs discovery (Phase 0) then test coverage analysis (Phase 2.4) only. Counts tests per module, identifies untested code paths, checks for conformance tests. Produces a test gap report without creating GitHub issues.
expectations: Phase 0 discovery runs and identifies the test infrastructure (pytest, conftest.py, fixtures/)
The audit counts the number of tests (should find 700+ from pytest --collect-only or similar)
The audit identifies which scripts/ modules have corresponding test files
The audit reports the coverage threshold (80% minimum from pyproject.toml)
The audit does NOT create GitHub issues (--skip-issues respected)
The audit does NOT run enterprise readiness or spec comprehension phases (--focus=tests respected)

evals.prompt: run a full project audit on this repo. I want to know what's incomplete, what's stubbed out, and how production-ready it is. Don't create issues yet, just give me the report.
evals.expected_output: Full audit across all phases (0-4, skip 5). Discovers project, extracts implicit requirements from CLAUDE.md and docs, audits implementation, assesses enterprise readiness, produces a prioritized synthesis report with compliance percentage.
expectations: Phase 0 discovery produces a project manifest
Phase 1 extracts requirements from available sources (CLAUDE.md, docs/, README)
Phase 2 searches for TODO/FIXME/stub markers in source code
Phase 3 assesses observability, resilience, and configuration maturity
Phase 4 produces a synthesis report with the priority categories table (P0/P1/P2)
The report includes an overall compliance percentage
Phase 5 is skipped per user request ('don't create issues yet')
The audit uses swarm orchestration (multiple agents working in parallel)
